data.name: Drunk Wizards
data.detailed_description:
Drunk Wizards combines the fluidity and skill of an arena shooter with the lighthearted fun of a party game. It's intense FFA arena with different spells.Collect "Magic" Ale to get more mana and use stronger magic.

Drunk Wizards is arena up to 4 players, providing immersive, fast-paced enemy fragging with different spells.

0.Morph

When tan out off mana you can save your life with Morph spell which turns enemy players into different object not allowing them to cast any spell.

1.Frostbolt

Fast ice attack which slos down enemy and dealing 35 dmg.

2.Death Coil

Strong dark magic spell, dealing 60 dmg. Has a chance to kill enemy with 1 strike.

3.Ice Wall

Creates an ice wall for 2 second to protect you from enemy spells(does not affect ice magic).

Upcoming spells:

Mana shield(reduces incoming dmg in cost of mana point).
Ice trap (freezes an enemy to ground).
Restoration(restores full hp)
+
Fell free to suggest any new spells in steam community hub

reviews.review:
The game itself has clumsy and feels strongly unpolished gameplay and overall presentation. I get they went for the 'cartoonish' graphic look but most of the gfx art and effects were bad, poorly made/designed so to speak. Same about the sound effects. Overall impression was not good. Also had to wait a friend to come and play as you need 2 players to start a match. I found no public matches at the occasion. Later, when I tried to play the game again it was already removed from my library.

[i]Updated: the developer gave me a key, so I could add the game on my library again. The developer mentioned that those who wanted to have the game back should contact them. I have to give them props for this, at least they want to set it right.[/i]

[h1]What happened?[/h1]

Game had been removed from library by decision of the developer!

[b]Initially this game was given for free, okay. But my main gripe with this game being revoked were (unconfirmed) reports of a problem to the users, as refunded/revoked games could cause a restriction for an user account and make trading card drops delay for 2h or more. However it seems this will not trigger this restriction.[/b]

Developer gave Steam keys to a group to promote their game through a giveaway using Gleam giveaway system. Then the developer decided to revoke all keys that were given away, probably because they want to sell his game through another site/bundle and realized that giving away many keys was a bad deal for them. Game got even removed from the bundle site later on.

http://steamcommunity.com/groups/DeductionsReviewClub#announcements/detail/798641222253726817

http://steamcommunity.com/app/479170/discussions/0/350532795338704703/

Horrible marketing strategy (before calling it something worse) by the developer. Things like this just ruin their reputation, if there was one, potentially tainting the promoter's. But at least it seems there was no money loss for the host of the giveaway.

I wish the developer better luck next time, if they can make it right and fix their mess!

EDIT: The developer made a giveaway on SteamGifts but not everyone that originally got the game could have access or receive a key as the site has a greater number of members and also certain restrictions apply to be able to register. https://www.steamgifts.com/giveaway/rPXRQ/drunk-wizards
